legal_ref: Ο περί Φόρου Προστιθέμενης Αξίας Νόμος 95(I)/2000, άρθρο 17 (as amended, incl. 167(I)/2012)
quote: Φ.Π.Α. επιβάλλεται με συντελεστή δεκαοκτώ τοις εκατόν (18%) για την περίοδο από 14 Ιανουαρίου 2013 μέχρι 12 Ιανουαρίου 2014 και με συντελεστή δεκαεννέα τοις εκατόν (19%) από 13 Ιανουαρίου 2014 — VAT is imposed at 18% from 14 Jan 2013 to 12 Jan 2014 and at 19% from 13 January 2014.
source_title: CyLaw — consolidated text of Law 95(I)/2000 on VAT (Cyprus Bar Association legal database; Tax Department site mof.gov.cy blocked by WAF)

reduced_rates.scope: hotel accommodation, restaurant/catering services, certain passenger transport (Twelfth Schedule, s.18A)
foodstuffs, pharmaceuticals, medical equipment, water, books-related items, passenger transport, admissions, hairdressing, renovation of dwellings, children's car seats etc. (Fifth Schedule, s.18)
books, newspapers, periodicals, certain disability aids, waste collection, sewage, first 140 theatre/circus performances (s.18B, inserted by 75(I)/2023)
exports, intra-EU supplies and certain zero-rated supplies (Sixth Schedule)

notes: VAT applies in the government-controlled areas of the Republic of Cyprus. TEDB cross-check: 19% standard; reduced 9/5/3/0 — consistent.
unverified: CyLaw is maintained by the Cyprus Bar Association, not the State; official Gazette/Tax Department text not fetched (mof.gov.cy returned Azure WAF 403)
amending law number (167(I)/2012) for the 19% rate inferred from the amendment notes beside s.17
